newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bonds slip marginally, becalmed up to FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Danish bonds slip marginally, becalmed up to FOMC.

text.p: Danish bond prices slipped on Monday in a quiet market waiting for Tuesday's FOMC meeting and becalmed ahead of the local Easter break starting midweek.
"What interest there has been has been centred on mortgage bonds. The market's going to be moribund until FOMC," one dealer said.
The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was down 0.08 point from the opening, 0.18 point lower than at Friday's close at 108.42 in turnover of 1.25 billion crowns.
The six percent mortgage bond due 2026 gained 0.10 point to 86.95.
The crown traded at 3.8117 per mark at 1150 gmt, down a smidgen from around 3.8115 at the opening.
The 10-year yield gap with Germany narrowed one basis point to 78.
